blocks.x: Is the audience any different in the two-fold?
Well, the audience in the garden is horrible.
What kind of people are they?
I don't know. They are drunkards and that kind of people. You know you are that too. They were screaming at all. They were screaming for the saints all the time. All the banjo tunes.
It was all kind of corny musicians.
Oh yeah, yeah. It wasn't the same with the sound before when I was there too. With these kind of people screaming.
Yeah. He's been there two weeks.
He's been there two weeks, I see. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
